text: At the organizational meeting of the Toronto District School Board held on November 17, 2022, the Board nominated Trustee Sara Ehrhardt as its representative on the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management for the term November 15, 2022 to November 14, 2026. The term of the previous TDSB representative on the Applegrove Board of Management, Trustee Michelle Aarts, concluded on November 14, 2022.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following representative to the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending November 14, 2026: - Trustee Sara Ehrhardt
